intent: Review the two email examples against the requirement for a persistent associated label, preserving their semantics, spacing, widths and order. Use compact verdict marks with accessible explanations to avoid floating-note collisions in the existing inline layout. Mount marks only while enabled; the installed React adapter destroys overlays and descriptions on unmount. CSS is already imported by build.mjs. Verify compiler/build, original-layout parity, interactions and cleanup in the browser.
